routing.ferries: none: a drive time never includes a boat
routing.rounding: minutes to the nearest whole minute; counts use the unrounded time

area.source: INE indicator 0008350, area of the territorial units (km²), from the Direção-Geral do Território (CAOP)

er.source: List of 56 general public hospitals with an emergency department (4 more, children's and maternity hospitals, are listed but not used) (SNS/ULS, SESARAM, the Azores hospitals), compiled per ULS on 2026-11-02; points from OpenStreetMap; each ULS checked against the SNS open-data file of emergency attendances 2026

cs.source: OpenStreetMap (Portugal extract of 2026-11-09, download.openstreetmap.fr): health centres by name (Centro de Saúde, USF, UCSP, Extensão de Saúde, Unidade de Saúde)

ph.source: The hospital groups' own lists of units (CUF, Luz, Lusíadas, Trofa Saúde, HPA; 2026-11-02) plus OSM private hospitals

pharm.source: OpenStreetMap (Portugal extract of 2026-11-09, download.openstreetmap.fr): amenity=pharmacy inside the municipality's boundary

isch.source: List of international schools (school sites and a third-party directory, 2026-11-02) plus OSM schools whose name says international

psch.source: OpenStreetMap (Portugal extract of 2026-11-09, download.openstreetmap.fr): amenity=school, private by tag or by name (Colégio, Externato)

sec.source: OpenStreetMap (Portugal extract of 2026-11-09, download.openstreetmap.fr): amenity=school whose name says Secundária, not private

beach.source: APA identified bathing waters 2026 (points), EEA bathing-water status 2024 (category), Associação Bandeira Azul awarded sites 2026 (flag)
beach.licence: APA: no restrictions stated; EEA: reuse with attribution

air.source: OpenStreetMap (Portugal extract of 2026-11-09, download.openstreetmap.fr): passenger terminal of the 14 airports with scheduled passenger flights (LIS, OPO, FAO, FNC, PXO and nine in the Azores)

rail.source: OpenStreetMap (Portugal extract of 2026-11-09, download.openstreetmap.fr): stations where the route relations of CP Alfa Pendular, Intercidades and the Porto–Vigo international train stop

food.source: MICHELIN Guide Portugal selection as listed on 2026-11-10 (mich_n30, mich_star_n30); OSM marketplaces named Mercado (mkt_n20); OSM amenity=restaurant in the municipality (rest_n) over the 2021 census population (rest_per_1k)

golf.source: The map's golf data (prompt 33): open courses

museum.source: OpenStreetMap (Portugal extract of 2026-11-09, download.openstreetmap.fr): tourism=museum and amenity=theatre, named
